label: Pig Iron
info: Crude high-carbon iron made as the first product from smelting iron ore; brittle and meant for further refining.

discovery.appearance: dark gray, silvery sheen, cast into ingot rows
discovery.notes: Handle as feedstock; too brittle for direct use.

recipe: Smelt iron ore in a blast furnace with coke as fuel and reducing agent
Use limestone flux to bind impurities into slag
Tap molten iron into sand molds to form pig ingots
